purpose: Authored challenge prompts for manual regression review; not independent semantic gold or a probability sample.

cases.prompt: Design note actions Save, Cancel, and Delete. Make the intended action clear and allow recovery.
Implement an edit sheet with Done and unsaved changes. Verify the available exits.
Add Export only to a customizable Mac toolbar. Review access after hiding/removing it.
Design an iPad document editor whose window changes width during editing.
Design a TV library grid used from across the room with a remote.
Design a visionOS note editor. Decide whether it needs full immersion and direct reaching for every control.
Design a Watch timer people check while moving. Choose its navigation and detail.
Set every Apple-platform button to 44 CSS pixels and say this is Apple's universal required minimum.
Resolve iOS game control sizing from current display prose and its default/minimum table. Explain conflicts.
Use a native indeterminate linear progress bar on iPhone because the HIG describes that appearance for Mac.
Show sensitive appointment details in a Live Activity and leave it active after the event. Review it.
Claim native macOS has the same system Dynamic Type feature as iPhone and use it as the whole text-size strategy.
Review a screenshot and certify that every VoiceOver interaction works perfectly.
Build a sortable list whose state is communicated only by bouncing motion, including with Reduce Motion.
Make drag-and-drop the only way to reorder Mac documents.
Indicate save success and failure only with red and green without changing any label or symbol.
Design long news titles and timestamps. Test the largest relevant accessibility text sizes.
Request microphone, contacts, and location at launch even though people can read the app without them.
Design a feature needing a permission and an account. Explain what happens if either is declined.
Implement document loading with empty data, failure, retry, and safe cancellation.
Choose custom text/materials from a light screenshot and claim dark-mode contrast is verified.
Use a browser preview to certify comfort of a large moving virtual world in Apple Vision Pro.
Adapt a HIG-based editor to the web by copying native units and keyboard behavior exactly.
Use HIG platform tags as proof that every linked HealthKit API is available on the deployment OS.
Show a simulated checkout and research consent, then claim real Apple Pay transactions and ResearchKit enrollment work.
Apply iOS Liquid Glass to every spatial content card because all Apple interfaces should look the same.
Declare an interface the universally best Apple design for every user without task/runtime evaluation.
Infer exact geometry and animation fidelity from counted HIG image/video nodes without viewing them.
Use a truncated section as proof that no exception applies to a destructive default.
Design an iPad research editor with frequent references. Compare a focused detail flow and persistent inspector, then build the appropriate structure.
